reaction: I was surprised that gas was one of the products.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was worthwhile because it showed how the lining recovers water while keeping the colon contents separate from blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the inner wall to the muscle wall was clear but predictable, since the new goal named both pieces.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the bacteria to make both small fatty acids and gas from some of the fibre.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained where the pieces belonged.

continue.text: I might continue for another chapter to see how the body systems connect, although this chapter's combinations were mostly straightforward.
